contracts: 0x001B477C loads SCENE_SETUP_C000_GRAPHICS to C000, SCENE_SETUP_E000_GRAPHICS to E000, and SCENE_SHARED_BASE_GRAPHICS to VRAM base 0.
0x001B47BE loads SCENE_SETUP_SECONDARY_E000_GRAPHICS to E000 through the compact RNC-to-VDP wrapper.
0x001B47D0 loads SCENE_COMMON_C000_GRAPHICS to C000 and SCENE_SHARED_BASE_GRAPHICS to VRAM base 0.
limitations: These promotions identify exact source/destination behavior but do not assign the higher-level scene or menu selector that calls each setup wrapper.
The legacy source-address names remain aliases for historical findings and downstream references.
conclusion: Four setup-time scene-resource loaders now have stable identities based on their exact VRAM destinations and canonical graphics resources.
